campaign_note: Acronis reported limited, targeted in-the-wild exploitation against the cPanel & WHM plugin only; no attacker, victim or count details were published in the sources read.

first_exploitation_claim.source: Acronis security advisory SEC-10986, as reported by Help Net Security (article dated 2026-09-16 says the advisory was published 'on Tuesday'; the advisory page itself returned no content when fetched, and The Hacker News says it is not clear when the activity was detected)

evidence.counts_what: vendor's qualitative description of in-the-wild exploitation; no count given
evidence.quote: Exploitation of this vulnerability has been detected in the wild in limited, targeted attacks.

campaign_note: Zero-day found by Haifei Li (EXPMON) from a PDF submitted to EXPMON on 2026-03-26; two malicious PDFs with Russian-language decoys were analyzed, and no victim count was published in the sources read.

first_exploitation_claim.source: Haifei Li / EXPMON blog post, as reported by Help Net Security on 2026-04-09 (the blog post's own date was not verified; its URL is https://justhaifei1.blogspot.com/2026/04/expmon-detected-sophisticated-zero-day-adobe-reader.html)

evidence.counts_what: malicious PDF samples analyzed (the 2026-03-26 EXPMON submission and one related variant); a sample count, not a victim count
evidence.measured_by: Haifei Li / EXPMON, as reported by Help Net Security
evidence.quote: The analysis of that and another related malicious PDF file revealed that

evidence.counts_what: date the variant sample was first submitted to VirusTotal, the basis for 'exploited since November 2025'
evidence.measured_by: Haifei Li / EXPMON, as reported by Help Net Security

campaign_note: Exploitation attempts against the ColdFusion RDS path traversal were seen on honeypots within days of Adobe's 2026-06-30 patch and watchTowr's analysis; no compromised-server or victim count was published in the sources read.

first_exploitation_claim.source: KEVIntel honeypot sensors (LinkedIn post), as reported by Help Net Security; CrowdSec separately dates its own first in-the-wild sighting to 2026-07-20

evidence.counts_what: internet-facing ColdFusion servers (exposed product, approximate; not a vulnerable count - the article says it is unknown how many run a vulnerable version or have RDS enabled)
evidence.measured_by: The Shadowserver Foundation, as reported by Help Net Security

evidence.counts_what: unique IP addresses seen attacking the flaw across the CrowdSec network (cumulative to report date)
evidence.quote: So far, 107 unique IP addresses have been seen attacking this flaw across our network.

campaign_note: Sansec found zero-day exploitation of Magento/Adobe Commerce starting 2026-09-04, three days before Adobe's hotfix, with at least two operators deploying a Rust Linux backdoor and a PHP web shell; no total count of compromised stores was published in the sources read.

first_exploitation_claim.source: Sansec research post (published 2026-09-05; states first confirmed exploitation at 2026-09-04 22:20 UTC)

evidence.counts_what: date attacks started, three days before the vendor hotfix; Sansec gives no count of compromised stores
evidence.quote: Adobe shipped its hotfix on September 7, three days after the first confirmed exploitation.

evidence.counts_what: compromised stores handled first-hand by one incident-response firm (a handful, not a population count)
evidence.quote: had first-hand experience with at least two compromised stores

evidence.counts_what: exploitation attempts against Previdian honeypots since 2026-09-07 (unsuccessful; from two unique IP addresses per the article)
evidence.measured_by: Previdian, as reported by The Hacker News
evidence.quote: 12 exploitation attempts have been recorded against its honeypots since September 7, 2026.
